purpose: Test the already-frozen WIDE SIGNAL rule family without post-hoc threshold tuning, using leakage-controlled yearly walk-forward reconstruction.

rules.A2_CORE: exactly one structural intersection horse (Ability Top3 x M3 Top3), that horse is Ability rank 2; frame market MID; choose best representative among axis-frame combinations ranked 2-12; Wide lower odds >=5.0
rules.PAIR2_SECOND: exactly two structural intersection horses including Ability rank 1; frame market MID/HIGH; choose the second representative among axis-frame combinations ranked 2-12; Wide lower odds >=5.0; MID is BUY candidate, HIGH is forward-research only
rules.candidate_score: Ability rank + M3 rank + P10 penalty, where penalty is 0/<20%, 1/20-<50%, 2/50-<65%, 4/>=65%
rules.frame_market_band: Neff ratio LOW <0.3582804561, MID <=0.5125919146, HIGH above
rules.LOGIC_C: Not evaluated as an active historical strategy because the current code path is effectively unreachable: it requires A1_RED, while current mobile-decision-core returns Ability-rank-1 single structure as green/yellow rather than red.

protocol.universe: JRA flat, field size >=12, 3-win class or higher
protocol.ability: Ability-v1 architecture, C=0.03, refit each test year only on earlier years (2017 onward); strictly prior high-class history
protocol.m3: M3 architecture reconstructed and refit each test year only on earlier years; remaining-600 and closing models use pre-race history; Ridge alpha=10 as pre-specified research reconstruction
protocol.p10: Position-risk architecture reconstructed with strictly prior history and race LOO pressure; logistic C=0.01 selected using 2017 train -> 2018 validation before the 2019-2026 test window
protocol.odds: TARGET final odds flag=4. Frame odds and Wide lower/upper ranges parsed from 2016_2025_odds.csv and 2026_odds.csv.
protocol.stake: fixed 1u per selected Wide pair; WIDE SIGNAL produces at most one selected pair for A2/PAIR2 in this test

interpretation: The frozen WIDE SIGNAL rule family does not explain the user's strong live Wide results over the long run.
The main BUY subset is below break-even even under the optimistic assumption that every hit pays the displayed Wide upper range.
Only 2024 is above 100% in the yearly lower-bound BUY results; therefore this is not a stable cross-era betting edge.
A2 CORE and PAIR2 SECOND both fail independently, so their combination should not be promoted or used as the explanation for current live profitability.
This result should not be repaired by searching new odds caps, P10 cutoffs, or distance/class subsets on the same 2019-2026 sample; that would create champion-data bias.
caveats: Historical odds are final odds rather than the user's actual T-15 decision-time snapshots.
Wide return is evaluated as a lower-bound and upper-bound range rather than exact historical payout for the selected pair.
Ability/M3/P10 are leakage-controlled walk-forward reconstructions of the current architecture, not literal application of 2026-fitted coefficients to old years.
Because the lower-bound ROI is about 64% and even the upper-bound ROI is about 70%, ordinary payout-range uncertainty is not large enough to reverse the conclusion.

decision.next_step: Investigate what differentiates the user's actually purchased profitable Wide bets from the frozen WIDE SIGNAL. Use the real purchase ledger/tags as a prospective hypothesis source, then pre-register one simple candidate rule and test it on a genuinely untouched historical/forward segment rather than tuning WIDE SIGNAL on 2019-2026.
